title: WsFrame::StateChange is raw Value while Response is typed — breaking asymmetry
description: WsFrame::StateChange(serde_json::Value) is untyped while WsFrame::Response(JmapResponse) is fully deserialized. Every caller must manually deserialize the StateChange payload, and there is no canonical type to copy. When a typed StateChange struct is added later it will be a breaking enum variant change. Extension crates (jmap-chat-client, jmap-mail-client) will each likely write their own deserialization, diverging silently. The asymmetry should be resolved before this API fossilizes.
